messages:
sara-cs: Quick QBR thread for Oceanic — need final slide owners, exec ask, and a dry-run. Renewal moved from green->amber; onboarding shows 2 failing integrations. Can we lock the deck by EOD Wed? Deck: https://redwood.app/decks/oceanic-qbr :spiral_calendar_pad:

mike-cs: I can own 'Usage & Cost' and the ask on unit economics. Will add a chart comparing last 6 weeks. Target: Wed 3pm PT. :thumbsup:

arjun-se: I'll take 'Technical Risk & Integrations' — will include error rates, failing endpoints, and a short remediation timeline. Question: do we want to surface the customer-reported logs or sanitize first?

ellie-ops: ops can schedule a hotfix window Wed 22:00 PT and be oncall. Runbook ref: /incidents/runbooks/oceanic-integration-fix. For the deck, I'll add a short bullet on rollback criteria.

sara-cs: Good. Assigning owners + quick asks below (please update in thread if you take another item)

```
Slide owners:
- Executive summary: sara-cs
- Usage & Cost: mike-cs
- Integrations & Tech Risk: arjun-se
- Onboarding status & CS health: lina-cs
- Enablement & Adoption plan: sara-cs
- Action items & Timeline: ellie-ops
```

sara-cs: Exec ask proposal: 10% credit contingent on 2-week platform SLA improvement + joint customer enablement sessions. @lina-cs can you confirm if customer will accept milestone-based credit?

lina-cs: I spoke with the champion — they're open to a milestone structure. Prefer cap at 10% and want a target date for the integrations fix. I'll draft a 1-line exec ask for the slide.

mike-cs: added interim cost-savings numbers but need the updated token usage CSV from analytics. @arjun-se can the ETL run be bumped to Wed 13:00 PT so charts refresh before I finalize?

arjun-se: Yep, I'll run the ETL Wed 13:00 PT and push the refreshed metrics to the shared sheet.

deply-bot: (automated) Note: patch pipeline for oceanic-integration-fix created (id #1234).

ellie-ops: deployment slot reserved Wed 22:00 PT. Ops will run smoke tests and holdback plan ready.

sara-cs: Final checklist: 1) Deck locked by Wed 17:00 PT, 2) ETL run Wed 13:00 PT, 3) Dry-run Thu 09:00 PT (invite execs + PM), 4) Hotfix Wed 22:00 PT. I'll send calendar invites once we lock slides.

mike-cs: ok locking my slide after ETL refresh.

arjun-se: I'll paste sanitized logs into slide appendix and link the runbook.

sara-cs: Thanks team — please react :white_check_mark: when your item is done. I'll follow up tomorrow with the invite and final ask language.
